63:

118: 
119: - **Outcome:** Browser/MCP mutations emit the same DAV changes as Apple mutations.

121: - **Scope:** Base event create/update/delete paths and transactional revisions.

123: - **Out of scope:** Moves, occurrences, imported feeds, sync response.

130: - **Outcome:** Apple receives only changes after its opaque token, including deletions.

140: 
141: - **Outcome:** No supported Happening mutation bypasses DAV sync.
142: - **Depends on:** T11.
143: - **Scope:** Moves, occurrence changes, supported external/imported paths, source-delete/target-create.

150: ## T13 — All-day semantics
151: 
152: - **Outcome:** All-day events round-trip without date shifts or conversion to timed events.

154: - **Scope:** DATE DTSTART/DTEND, exclusive end, timezone-independent mapping.

156: - **Out of scope:** Recurrence and floating timed events.

160: 
161: ## T14 — Recurrence semantics
162: 
163: - **Outcome:** Series and modified/deleted occurrences round-trip as one canonical resource.

165: - **Scope:** Supported RRULE, RECURRENCE-ID, EXDATE, master ETag/mutation mapping.

173: 
174: - **Outcome:** DAV matches Happening permissions and never makes imported content writable.

176: - **Scope:** Owner/editor/viewer/free-busy, revocation, imported resources, path ownership.

178: - **Out of scope:** New roles/sharing UI.
179: - **Acceptance:** Roles pass the access matrix; revocation is immediate; foreign existence is hidden; imported writes fail.
180: - **Verify:** Table-driven service/HTTP authorization tests.
181: - **Handoff:** Supply matrix and denial codes to T18/T19.

183: ## T16 — Safe client-property preservation
184: 
185: - **Outcome:** Apple edits preserve approved client-owned metadata.
186: - **Depends on:** T14.
187: - **Scope:** Allowlisted alarms, categories, URL, transparency, selected X-properties.
188: - **Changes:** Parse, validate, persist, merge, serialize allowlist; reject scheduling/unsupported components.

192: - **Handoff:** Freeze allowlist/examples for docs.

195: 
196: - **Outcome:** Users safely set up, inspect, revoke, and disconnect devices.

198: - **Scope:** Disconnected, one-time secret, connected, attention, revoke-one, disconnect-all states.

200: - **Out of scope:** Configuration profiles and Apple credentials.

202: - **Verify:** Frontend tests and Playwright lifecycle with immediate DAV failure after revoke.
203: - **Handoff:** T18/T19 reuse setup/error language.
204: 
205: ## T18 — Production hardening
206: 
207: - **Outcome:** DAV fails safely under malformed, oversized, brute-force, or insecure traffic.
208: - **Depends on:** T11, T15, T17.
209: - **Scope:** Parser/body/report limits, DAV rate limits, redacted logs, metrics, HTTPS/proxy validation.
210: - **Changes:** Add bounded middleware/parsers, safe telemetry, and fail-closed production transport checks.
211: - **Out of scope:** General observability redesign.
212: - **Acceptance:** Violations fail before writes; auth throttling is independent; logs contain no credentials/bodies; insecure production config fails closed.
213: - **Verify:** Adversarial suite, redaction/rate tests, production-config smoke test.
214: - **Handoff:** Provide operator checklist and sanitized diagnostics.
215: 
216: ## T19 — Apple compatibility, cleanup, and docs
217: 
218: - **Outcome:** Current macOS/iOS Calendar completes connect, sync, CRUD, and revoke.
219: - **Depends on:** T12, T14, T16, T18.
220: - **Scope:** Real-client acceptance, sanitized fixtures, legacy fake-CalDAV/WebCal cleanup, deployment/user docs.
221: - **Changes:** Test Apple clients; encode protocol differences as regressions; remove misleading scaffold while retaining explicit one-off ICS export.
222: - **Out of scope:** Apple credentials, Apple-side calendar creation/deletion, scheduling, tasks/journals, configuration profiles.
223: - **Acceptance:** Both clients connect; initial/incremental sync and supported CRUD work; revoke fails next request; UI/docs match reality.
224: - **Verify:** Signed device checklist, full DAV/frontend/backend suites, deployment smoke test.
225: - **Handoff:** Release only after this passes; record supported OS versions/limits.
226: 
227: ## Gate 4 summary
228: 
229: - 19 packets: 2 complete, 17 awaiting approval.
230: - 14 waves with limited safe parallelism.
231: - Highest-risk packet: T14 recurrence semantics.
232: - Release boundary: T19; earlier packets are integration checkpoints.

(End of file - total 232 lines)

558: /// Conditional `PUT` that creates one supported timed, non-recurring event
559: /// through the domain service and persists the DAV resource mapping.
560: ///
561: /// Requires `If-None-Match: *`. Fails with 412 when the resource already
562: /// exists, 409 when the client-supplied UID is already mapped in the
563: /// calendar, and rolls back the event when the mapping cannot be written.
564: async fn handle_put_create_event_resource(
565:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
566:     session: &DavSession,
567:     principal_id: &str,
568:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
569:     resource_name: &str,
570:     request: Request,
571: ) -> Response {
572:     let if_none_match = request
573:         .headers()
574:         .get(header::IF_NONE_MATCH)
575:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
576:     if if_none_match != Some("*") {
577:         return (
578:             StatusCode::PRECONDITION_REQUIRED,
579:             "If-None-Match: * is required to create a resource",
580:         )
581:             .into_response();
582:     }
583: 
584:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(&calendar.role) else {
585:         return dav_server_error();
586:     };
587:     if authorize_calendar_action(
588:         UserStatus::Active,
589:         Some(PlatformRole::User),
590:         Some(role),
591:         CalendarAction::CreateEvent,
592:     ) != AuthorizationDecision::Allow
593:     {
594:         return dav_resource_not_found();
595:     }
596: 
597:     let body = match axum::body::to_bytes(request.into_body(), query::MAX_BODY_BYTES).await {
598:         Ok(body) => body,
599:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("request body too large"),
600:     };
601:     let body_str = match std::str::from_utf8(&body) {
602:         Ok(value) => value,
603:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("request body must be UTF-8"),
604:     };
605:     let parsed = match parse_calendar(body_str, IcsParserLimits::default()) {
606:         Ok(parsed) => parsed,
607:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("invalid calendar data"),
608:     };
609:     if parsed.events.len() != 1 {
610:         return dav_bad_request("exactly one VEVENT is required");
611:     }
612:     let incoming = &parsed.events[0];
613:     if incoming.rrule.is_some() || incoming.recurrence_id.is_some() {
614:         return dav_bad_request("recurring events are not supported");
615:     }
616:     let timing = match &incoming.timing {
617:         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::Timed {
618:             starts_at,
619:             ends_at,
620:             timezone,
621:         } => EventTiming::Timed {
622:             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
623:             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
624:             timezone: timezone.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
625:         },
626:         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
627:             start_date,
628:             end_date,
629:         } => EventTiming::AllDay {
630:             start_date: start_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
631:             end_date: end_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
632:         },
633:     };
634:     if timing_end_not_after_start(&timing) {
635:         return dav_bad_request("event end must be after start");
636:     }
637:     let status = match incoming.status.as_deref() {
638:         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
639:         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
640:         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
641:     };
642:     if incoming.summary.trim().is_empty() {
643:         return dav_bad_request("SUMMARY is required");
644:     }
645: 
646:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
647:     if repository
648:         .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource_name)
649:         .await
650:         .ok()
651:         .flatten()
652:         .is_some()
653:     {
654:         return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "resource already exists").into_response();
655:     }
656: 
657:     let mutation = EventMutation {
658:         title: incoming.summary.clone(),
659:         description: incoming.description.clone(),
660:         location: incoming.location.clone(),
661:         status,
662:         timing,
663:     };
664:     let event_service = EventService::new_at(accounts.pool().clone(), accounts.now());
665:     let projection = match event_service
666:         .create(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, mutation)
667:         .await
668:     {
669:         Ok(projection) => projection,
670:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
671:     };
672:     let event_id = projection.id;
673: 
674:     let now = accounts.now();
675:     let resource = match repository
676:         .create_resource(
677:             calendar.calendar_id,
678:             event_id,
679:             &incoming.uid,
680:             resource_name,
681:             now,
682:         )
683:         .await
684:     {
685:         Ok(resource) => resource,
686:         Err(error) => {
687:             let _ = event_service
688:                 .delete(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, event_id)
689:                 .await;
690:             return match error {
691:                 CaldavAuthError::ResourceExists => {
692:                     (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "resource already exists").into_response()
693:                 }
694:                 CaldavAuthError::UidConflict => {
695:                     (StatusCode::CONFLICT, "uid already exists in calendar").into_response()
696:                 }
697:                 _ => dav_server_error(),
698:             };
699:         }

891: /// precondition is missing or stale, without mutating the event. On success the
892: /// event is deleted and the resource row is tombstoned (event reference
893: /// cleared, deletion stamped) so the mapping survives for other clients. If the
894: /// domain delete fails after the tombstone is written, the tombstone is
895: /// compensated back to the live mapping.
896: async fn handle_delete_event_resource(
897:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
898:     session: &DavSession,
899:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
900:     resource_name: &str,
901:     request: Request,
902: ) -> Response {
903:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(&calendar.role) else {
904:         return dav_server_error();

907:         UserStatus::Active,
908:         Some(PlatformRole::User),
909:         Some(role),
910:         CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent,
911:     ) != AuthorizationDecision::Allow
912:     {
913:         return dav_resource_not_found();
914:     }
915: 
916:     let if_match = request
917:         .headers()
918:         .get(header::IF_MATCH)
919:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
920:     let Some(if_match) = if_match else {
921:         return (
922:             StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED,
923:             "If-Match is required to delete a resource",
924:         )
925:             .into_response();
926:     };
927: 
928:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
929:     let resource = match repository
930:         .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource_name)
931:         .await
932:     {
933:         Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
934:         Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
935:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
936:     };
937:     if event_is_imported(accounts.pool(), resource.event_id).await {
938:         return dav_resource_not_found();
939:     }
940: 
941:     let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
942:         .event(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id)
943:         .await
944:     {
945:         Ok(Some(event)) => event,
946:         Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
947:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
948:     };
949:     let Some((_, current_etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event, DavReadAccess::Details) else {
950:         return dav_resource_not_found();
951:     };
952:     if !etag_matches(if_match, &current_etag) {
953:         return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "precondition failed").into_response();
954:     }
955: 
956:     let now = accounts.now();
957:     let tombstoned = match repository
958:         .tombstone_resource(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id, now)
959:         .await
960:     {
961:         Ok(tombstoned) => tombstoned,
962:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
963:     };

965:         // The live mapping disappeared between the precondition check and the
966:         // tombstone write; treat as an already-deleted resource.
967:         return dav_resource_not_found();
968:     }
969: 
970:     let event_service = EventService::new_at(accounts.pool().clone(), accounts.now());
971:     let delete_result = event_service
972:         .delete(
973:             session.user_id,
974:             false,
975:             calendar.calendar_id,
976:             resource.event_id,
977:         )
978:         .await;
979:     if let Err(error) = delete_result {
980:         // Compensate the tombstone so the mapping is not left dangling.
981:         let _ = repository
982:             .restore_resource(
983:                 calendar.calendar_id,
984:                 resource.event_id,
985:                 resource_name,
986:                 accounts.now(),
987:             )

990:             EventServiceError::NotFound => dav_resource_not_found(),

993:         };
994:     }
995: 
996:     // The tombstone was applied before the domain delete, so the change-log
997:     // entry recorded by the domain service could not resolve the resource name
998:     // from the live mapping. Stamp it now so sync-collection can emit the
999:     // correct href for this deletion.
1000:     let _ = repository
1001:         .stamp_change_resource_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id, resource_name)
1002:         .await;
1003: 
1004:     StatusCode::NO_CONTENT.into_response()

1255: /// Handle a `sync-collection` REPORT: return the changes since the client's
1256: /// opaque token (or the full snapshot when no token is supplied) and mint a
1257: /// new token for the next incremental sync.

1259: /// Deleted resources are represented by a response whose `D:status` is
1260: /// `HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found` as a direct child of `D:response`, per RFC
1261: /// 6578. Invalid tokens fail safely with 400. Pagination is bounded by
1262: /// `MAX_RESULTS` and the new token always advances past the last returned
1263: /// revision, so no change is skipped.
1264: async fn handle_sync_collection(
1265:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
1266:     principal_id: &str,
1267:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
1268:     sync: &query::SyncCollection,
1269: ) -> Response {
1270:     let Some(access) = read_access_for_role(&calendar.role) else {
1271:         return dav_calendar_not_found();
1272:     };
1273:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
1274:     let events = EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
1275:     let now = accounts.now();
1276: 
1277:     let mut responses = Vec::new();
1278:     let new_revision;
1279: 
1280:     match &sync.sync_token {
1281:         Some(token) => {
1282:             // Incremental sync: decode the opaque token and page the change log.
1283:             let Some(revision) = accounts.decode_sync_token(token) else {
1284:                 return dav_bad_request("invalid sync token");
1285:             };
1286:             let changes = match repository
1287:                 .list_changes_since(calendar.calendar_id, revision, MAX_RESULTS)
1288:                 .await
1289:             {
1290:                 Ok(changes) => changes,
1291:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1292:             };
1293:             new_revision = changes.last().map(|change| change.id).unwrap_or(revision);

fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
    let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
        authorize_calendar_action(
            UserStatus::Active,
            Some(PlatformRole::User),
            Some(role),
            action,
        ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
    };
    let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
    let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
    if can_read {
        privileges.push("DAV:read");
        privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
    }
    if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
        privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
    }
    let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
    if writable {
        privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
        privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
    }
    if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
        privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
    }
    if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
        privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
        privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
    }
    if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
        privileges.push("DAV:write");
    }
    if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
        privileges.push("DAV:all");
    }
    privileges
}

fn privilege_set_xml(privileges: &[&str]) -> String {
    let entries = privileges
        .iter()
        .map(|privilege| format!("        <D:privilege>\n          <D:href>{privilege}</D:href>\n        </D:privilege>"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("\n");
    format!(
        "      <D:current-user-privilege-set>\n{entries}\n      </D:current-user-privilege-set>"
    )
}

/// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event, rendered
/// at the caller's read scope. Free-busy readers receive a placeholder that
/// carries only the time window.
fn ical_and_etag(
    resource: &CaldavEventResource,
    event: &Event,
    access: DavReadAccess,
) -> Option<(String, String)> {
    let timing = match &event.timing {
        EventTiming::Timed {
            start_utc,
            end_utc,
            timezone,
        } => CaldavIcalTiming::Timed {
            start_utc: *start_utc,
            end_utc: *end_utc,
            timezone: timezone.clone(),
        },
        EventTiming::AllDay {
            start_date,
            end_date,
        } => CaldavIcalTiming::AllDay {
            start_date: start_date.clone(),
            end_date: end_date.clone(),
        },
    };
    let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
        uid: resource.uid.clone(),
        summary: event.title.clone(),
        description: event.description.clone(),
        location: event.location.clone(),
        status: Some(
            match event.status {
                EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
                EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
                EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
            }
            .to_owned(),
        ),
        timing,
        dtstamp: event.created_at,
        sequence: event.version as u64,
        free_busy: matches!(access, DavReadAccess::FreeBusy),
    });
    let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
    Some((ical, etag))
}

}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct CreatePasswordRequest {
    label: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct CreatePasswordResponse {
    server_url: String,
    username: String,
    clear_password: String,
    password: CredentialMetadata,
}

async fn get_apple_connection(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    let status = accounts
        .status(session.user.id)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    Ok(Json(status))
}

async fn create_apple_password(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
    Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
    if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
    }
    let issued = accounts
        .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
        server_url: issued.server_url,
        username: issued.username,
        clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
        password: issued.metadata,
    };
    Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
}

async fn revoke_apple_password(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
    Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    accounts
        .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
        .await
        .map_err(|error| match error {
            CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
            other => map_caldav_error(other),
        })?;
    Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
}

async fn disconnect_apple(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    accounts
        .revoke_all(session.user.id)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
}

fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
    match error {
        CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
        CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
        CaldavAuthError::ResourceExists | CaldavAuthError::UidConflict => ApiError::internal(),
        CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
    }
}

        let mut builder = Request::builder()
            .method(Method::from_bytes(b"PROPFIND").unwrap())
            .uri(uri)
            .header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
        if let Some(depth) = depth {
            builder = builder.header("depth", depth);

        let request = builder.body(Body::empty()).unwrap();
        let response = app.oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
        let status = response.status();

        (status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
    }
